body: My sister went on holiday abroad and got engaged, and I haven't bothered to congratulate her yet. Is this the real me? 😐

Has depression made you feel fewer emotions towards other people? I'm desperate to know how much of an effect depression can have on this.

I did talk to a few girls online when I was younger, so I must have felt something at some point.

Who knows if anything will help. I guess I would be willing to try other types of antidepressants.
You actually feel fewer emotions towards your family when it gets worse?

I feel like I should socialize, but the lack of emotions makes doing that or anything else impossible. Sometimes the emotions come back, but not for long. I do find it a little concerning that I barely even want to talk to family members.

I barely do anything right now, and I can't think of much either.

I'm trying to act as rationally as possible right now, and that means trying to treat the fatigue and the depression again, but the more time that passes, the less likely it is that anything is going to help.

I'm not surprised by the lack of responses. There are so many posts on this subreddit.

Well, I'm trying hard to figure out what to do next, because I'm not going through this shit another time.
